field.definition: F_t: observed face flux, one scalar per interior edge; missing (date, phase) pairs contribute no row, never a zero
field.missing: absent pair -> no row; N == 0 is not imputed
field.phase: the scale's own clock phase: 24 per day at dt=60 min, 96 at dt=15 min

geometry.face_order: row-major, east faces first, then north; rebuilt from the grid mask and asserted equal to um_ctx p0/p1 on every load

metrics.E: E(v, v_hat) = sum ||v - v_hat||^2 / sum ||v||^2 over rows of the evaluation block
metrics.bootstrap: unit = independent TEST date; percentile 2.5/97.5; n=10000, seed=20261028

frames.D: centre every row with TRAIN phase means; score the anomaly z; denominator ||z||^2
frames.I: D's prediction plus TRAIN phase mean; denominator ||y||^2
frames.P: centre FIT rows only; predict from raw TEST x; score raw TEST y; denominator ||y||^2  (the manuscript's 1 - E)

metrics.identity: R_I - R_CLIM = (1 - R_CLIM) R_D holds by construction for D/I/CLIM; checked every run against 1e-12

operators.complexity: one eigendecomposition per split; no kernel, no nonlinearity, no per-object tuning beyond kappa
operators.estimator: ridge in dual form: a = V ((V^T T) / (s + lam)), pred = (X_pred X_fit^T) a, s eig(X_fit X_fit^T)
operators.field: F_t: observed face flux, one scalar per interior edge; missing (date, phase) pairs contribute no row, never a zero
operators.projector: P_0 = I - D^+ D, gauge cell 0 pinned; D^+ from a sparse LU of D D^T with row/column 0 removed
operators.regularisation: relative: lam = kappa * s_max(X_fit X_fit^T); kappa chosen on VAL only, grid fixed in metrics.KAPPA
operators.source: x_t = D F_t, D the NC x n_int face-to-cell incidence matrix (+1 head cell, -1 tail cell), row-major east/north face order
operators.target: y_t = U^T (P_0 F_t), U the r-column orthonormal road-response basis of the object
